All the signs point to Siri AI arriving on HomePod via new hardware, as leaker pdfu shared today a possible look at what the new Siri could look like on HomePod.

HomePod 27's code has added support for Siri AI, along with a redesigned status indicator light

Apple typically does not discuss future products, but long-rumored reports suggest that Siri AI will debut on the upcoming new Apple TV 4K and HomePod devices.

When Apple announced Siri AI in June, it made no mention of the assistant coming to tvOS or HomePod. Many suspect this is because the new Siri requires yet-to-be-announced new hardware to operate.

A new post on X by leaker pdfu may give us our first glimpse of what Siri AI looks like running on HomePod. Here's the post and video:

As mentioned in the post, the HomePod 27 software already includes the code needed to run Siri AI, but it has not yet been enabled for users.

In a follow-up post, pdfu clarified that it cannot be confirmed whether Siri AI will be limited to new hardware only, but it appears to be an almost inevitable outcome.

If Apple intended to bring Siri AI to older HomePod models, they would have announced this feature in June. The company's complete silence on Siri AI for the HomePod lineup strongly suggests strict hardware limitations.

What do you think about the new design of Siri AI on HomePod? Share your thoughts in the comments section.
